evidence: CVE-2026-74878 remains PUBLISHED at https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-74878 (VulnCheck CNA; not rejected). Vendor GHSA-h45m-mgcp-q388 is published, withdrawn_at null. GitHub global GHSA-crfx-7r98-6r44 is published, withdrawn_at null, and wraps the same CVE.

Source: TOTPRateLimiter in openssl_encrypt_server/modules/pepper/totp.py stores attempts and lockouts in process-local dicts (BIC 1b6f732232018609189c863a165a11aaa89db250: self.attempts = defaultdict(list), self.lockouts = {}). TOTPService holds a class-level _rate_limiter = TOTPRateLimiter().

Sink: TOTPService.verify_code calls self._rate_limiter.check_rate_limit(client.cert_fingerprint) before TOTP/backup verification, then record_attempt on failure. Independent worker processes and restarts do not share that state, so distributed or post-restart attempts bypass the nominal 5/5min lockout.
The same in-memory class is in public PyPI openssl-encrypt 1.4.0b3 and 1.4.0b8 wheels (totp.py has TOTPRateLimiter + _rate_limiter = TOTPRateLimiter() and no DatabaseBackend).

Smallest surviving public first-write is 1b6f732232018609189c863a165a11aaa89db250 (single parent c21f2a81b6bc6999c4067d1b2e4ea6d97448d037; single file openssl_encrypt_server/modules/pepper/totp.py; +177/-11).

git log --all -S TOTPRateLimiter shows 1b6f732232018609189c863a165a11aaa89db250 as the add. Parent totp.py blob 8a704d66d5ae6805112a81e742feb6b98fb562f9 equals the original 9872c84399d869443dd880772bf818881b1fafdb totp.py (verify_code with no limiter). BIC blob is 836f7b716241d19714983a8b01d84b49ed0ff658.

Immediate parent c21f2a81b6bc6999c4067d1b2e4ea6d97448d037 totp.py has class TOTPService and async def verify_code with pyotp.TOTP.verify / backup-code checks only: no TOTPRateLimiter, no defaultdict attempts/lockouts, no check_rate_limit.
1b6f732232018609189c863a165a11aaa89db250 is the first commit that inserts those symbols and wires them into verify_code.

1b6f732232018609189c863a165a11aaa89db250 has exactly one parent (git rev-list --parents: 1b6f732232018609189c863a165a11aaa89db250 c21f2a81b6bc6999c4067d1b2e4ea6d97448d037) and one path in git diff-tree. Not a merge, squash aggregate, move, or revert. No finer public member reconstructable.

Advisory/CVE range 0..<1.4.0 is overbroad for stable 1.3.x: GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 git rev-parse v1.3.6^{commit} = f69305effbab0bdc0c8df0f2297cdfddf8929b6e; openssl_encrypt_server is absent and totp.py does not exist. That does not disprove the vulnerability.

Public pip artifacts in the claimed <1.4.0 range do contain the mechanism. PyPI openssl-encrypt 1.4.0b3 (uploaded 2026-01-04; setup.py VERSION=1.4.0b3 at 44b97eedce1e7ecd78626ae09fe0e5037d54f479, which has 1b6f732232018609189c863a165a11aaa89db250 as ancestor and not 2749bc0949b34a5921a35fb4a3f1856fc51916de) ships openssl_encrypt_server/modules/pepper/totp.py with process-local TOTPRateLimiter. PyPI 1.4.0b4–1.4.0b8 likewise. Git tags for 1.4.0b* were not retained on origin; the PyPI wheels are first-party public objects.

Git tags v1.4.0 (768df5cd1910e349509f07a27eeac6951e0003bf), v1.4.1rc1 (8e255e5e9bfe9454d4a7360d29919653cf9fd3a6), v1.4.1rc2 (b16085bc4abdbb6f5e7dc5d2e621ff1e005867cf), and v1.4.1 (9d2f6208d9be61571dfd87a1a28b3bab8f36a524) also still construct TOTPService._rate_limiter = TOTPRateLimiter() with InMemoryBackend default.

CVE/vendor claim 1.4.0 unaffected. v1.4.0 peels to 768df5cd1910e349509f07a27eeac6951e0003bf and is an ancestor of 2749bc0949b34a5921a35fb4a3f1856fc51916de, but totp.py still has `_rate_limiter = TOTPRateLimiter()` and `self.backend = InMemoryBackend()` when backend is None (also in the PyPI 1.4.0 wheel). git grep on v1.4.0/v1.4.1 finds no production DatabaseBackend(...) construction.

Vendor advisory text 'defaults to DatabaseBackend when DB available' is contradicted by 2749bc0949b34a5921a35fb4a3f1856fc51916de itself ('Default is InMemoryBackend with a warning'). v1.4.2+ drop openssl_encrypt_server from this repo (chore move), which is not a limiter fix.

2749bc0949b34a5921a35fb4a3f1856fc51916de (parent f4a1ba660063cd9e17883829e5272a248525a16b; one file totp.py) adds RateLimitBackend/InMemoryBackend/DatabaseBackend but leaves TOTPService._rate_limiter = TOTPRateLimiter() so production still uses process-local dicts. git log -S 'DatabaseBackend(' never shows a production selector.

No later commit in this clone wires DatabaseBackend into TOTPService. Mechanism remains open on every inspected tree that still has totp.py. Unpatched.confirmed=true for this repository; 2749bc0949b34a5921a35fb4a3f1856fc51916de is an incomplete attempt, not a direct fix.

Primary treated v1.3.6 (f69305effbab0bdc0c8df0f2297cdfddf8929b6e, no openssl_encrypt_server) as proving no affected release. That misses public pip 1.4.0b3–1.4.0b8 (<1.4.0) which ship totp.py with process-local TOTPRateLimiter and do not contain 2749bc0949b34a5921a35fb4a3f1856fc51916de.
Atomic BIC is 1b6f732232018609189c863a165a11aaa89db250 (parent c21f2a81b6bc6999c4067d1b2e4ea6d97448d037 lacks the limiter). Primary left introducer_sha null.

Claimed fix 2749bc0949b34a5921a35fb4a3f1856fc51916de does not close the sink: default remains InMemoryBackend and TOTPService never selects DatabaseBackend. v1.4.0 and v1.4.1 (and their PyPI wheels) still have the process-local limiter.
BIC 1b6f732232018609189c863a165a11aaa89db250 carries Claude Code / Claude Sonnet 4.5 co-author markers, so AI attribution on the BIC is positive rather than UNKNOWN.

unpatched.reason: 2749bc0949b34a5921a35fb4a3f1856fc51916de adds DatabaseBackend but TOTPService._rate_limiter = TOTPRateLimiter() still defaults to InMemoryBackend; no production assignment selects DatabaseBackend on v1.4.0/v1.4.1 or later trees that retain totp.py. Removing openssl_encrypt_server after v1.4.1 is a repo split, not a limiter fix.

potential_fix.approach: Construct TOTPService._rate_limiter with DatabaseBackend (or another shared persistent store) whenever a DB session exists, and refuse InMemoryBackend as the production default.
potential_fix.rationale: Shared persistent attempt/lockout state is visible to every worker and survives restart, closing the distribute-across-instances and retry-after-restart bypass of check_rate_limit in verify_code.

corrected_fields.bug_semantics: TOTPService.verify_code consults a class-level TOTPRateLimiter whose attempt and lockout maps are process-local dictionaries (later wrapped as unused-by-default InMemoryBackend). Multiple workers enforce independent counters and a restart discards them, so distributed or post-restart TOTP guesses bypass the nominal 5-attempt/15-minute lockout.
corrected_fields.flaw_origin: First public write of the in-memory limiter is 1b6f732232018609189c863a165a11aaa89db250. Parent c21f2a81b6bc6999c4067d1b2e4ea6d97448d037 totp.py has unthrottled verify_code. Public pip 1.4.0b3–1.4.0b8 are in the advisory's <1.4.0 range and contain that limiter; 1.3.x stable tags do not. 1.4.0/1.4.1 still default to InMemoryBackend.
